graph.name: 12. Plan, write, polish, and annotate one reply
graph.description:
Put the earlier lessons together: plan a scene, write its reply, polish the narration, and add item notes. You will also learn to keep observed facts separate from suggested details.

What you'll learn:
• Combine the planning, revision, and notes from lessons 3, 7, and 8.
• Treat a model’s added interpretation as a suggestion, not evidence.

Before you start:
• Open this lesson in a practice chat and enable Lattice before Send. The main reply uses your current SillyTavern connection.
• Choose model connections for Response Plan, Revise Draft, Extract, and Enrich. Active SillyTavern can serve each role. Use a scene with a few physical items to make the notes easy to compare.

Steps:
1. Follow Scene Context into Response Plan. The planner receives five recent public messages and suggests the next beat without choosing the player’s action.
2. Send a message to continue the scene. Compare Generate Reply’s draft with Revise Draft’s output: the polishing pass should preserve dialogue, facts, and actions.
3. Inspect Extract’s item records and their quotes. Enrich then suggests a sensory detail for each observed item using the public scene context.
4. Read the dropdown in the final reply. Check which details were actually in the text and which were added as suggestions. If the canvas has a group, folding it only hides its boxes; the wires still control the work.
5. Review the final reply and any proposed saved changes at Review / Publish. Choose Apply reviewed candidate to accept them, or Reject candidate to discard them. Preview alone does not save changes.

Checkpoints:
Enrich → out: The notes retain the original quoted observations and label added details as suggestions.

Try this:
Try a scene whose reply mentions no physical items.
Enrich skips its request when there are no items to describe. You still have a reply to review.

If something is different:
The item list is empty: The workflow keeps the reply without inventing observations to fill the notes.

Model requests: Up to four extra requests: plan, polish, extract items, and suggest details. SillyTavern writes one reply.

plan.title: Response Plan
plan.instructions: Plan the next public beat, leaving the player decision open.

polish.title: Revise Draft
polish.instructions: Make narration clear and concise. Copy dialogue, facts and actions unchanged.

items.title: Extract
items.instructions: Extract explicitly observed physical items with exact quotes. Mentions do not establish ownership.

suggestions.title: Enrich
suggestions.instructions: For each observed item suggest one sensory detail consistent with public context. Label additions as suggestions, never observed facts.
